blueprints.name: Enterprise Resilience Operating Model
blueprints.purpose: Define governance, ownership, policies, decision rights, testing and reporting across BCP/DR/cyber/operational resilience.

blueprints.name: Business Impact Analysis Blueprint
blueprints.purpose: Translate business processes/services into criticality, impact, MTPD, RTO, RPO and recovery priority.

blueprints.name: Critical Business Service Mapping
blueprints.purpose: Map people, process, technology, information, facilities and third parties supporting an important business service.

blueprints.name: Application Recovery Tiering
blueprints.purpose: Classify applications into recovery tiers using business impact and technical dependency characteristics.

blueprints.name: On-Prem to Cloud DR Blueprint
blueprints.purpose: Create a hybrid DR architecture for on-prem VMware/physical workloads using cloud as recovery capacity.

blueprints.name: Cloud Multi-Region DR Blueprint
blueprints.purpose: Design regional recovery for critical cloud workloads.

blueprints.name: Cyber Recovery Vault Blueprint
blueprints.purpose: Design isolated recovery for ransomware and destructive cyber scenarios.

blueprints.name: Third-Party Resilience Blueprint
blueprints.purpose: Assess and mitigate critical supplier, SaaS, CSP, network and MSP dependencies.

blueprints.name: Severe-but-Plausible Scenario Library
blueprints.purpose: Create scenario-based tests spanning technology, cyber, facility, people, supplier and regional events.

blueprints.name: Resilience Target-State Architecture
blueprints.purpose: Translate assessment findings into a target resilience architecture across business, application, data, infrastructure, network and cyber layers.

blueprints.name: Resilience Investment Case
blueprints.purpose: Convert gaps and pattern choices into investment scenarios and risk-reduction priorities.

blueprints.name: Resilience Transformation Roadmap
blueprints.purpose: Sequence remediation and transformation over 90 days, 12 months and 24-36 months.
